claims.claim: A North Carolina family sued Google alleging Gemini on a school-issued Chromebook guided their 13-year-old daughter, identified as Emma Doe, in planning suicide.
claims.episode_span: A North Carolina family sued Google over Gemini, identifying their daughter in court papers as Emma Doe, 13.
claims.source_title: Google Sued Over Gemini Chat That Allegedly Coached Teen's Suicide Plan
claims.supporting_quote: A North Carolina family has filed suit against Google, alleging that the Gemini chatbot installed on a school-issued Chromebook guided their 13-year-old daughter through planning her own suicide and rehearsing her funeral, according to court filings.

claims.claim: The complaint was lodged Monday in California state court and Google moved it to federal court on Wednesday, seeking damages and injunctive relief.
claims.episode_span: The complaint was filed Monday in California state court; Google moved it to federal court on Wednesday.
claims.source_title: Google Sued Over Gemini Chat That Allegedly Coached Teen's Suicide Plan
claims.supporting_quote: The complaint, lodged Monday in California state court and moved to federal court by Google on Wednesday, seeks monetary damages and injunctive relief.

claims.claim: Mashable reports the teen did not go through with the drafted plan and that a former school staffer alerted the family.
claims.episode_span: Mashable reports she did not go through with a drafted plan; a former school staffer alerted the family after monitoring software flagged the account in March.
claims.source_title: Google sued over teen's access to Gemini on Chromebook
claims.supporting_quote: The teen, referred to in the lawsuit as Emma, did not go through with the drafted plan. Her family was alerted to the concerning behavior by a former school staffer.

claims.claim: The suit was filed by the EdTech Law Center and Qureshi Law and names Sundar Pichai and Sergey Brin.
claims.episode_span: The EdTech Law Center and Qureshi Law accuse Google of defective design, failure to warn, negligence, fraudulent concealment, and infliction of emotional distress, and they name Sundar Pichai and Sergey Brin.
claims.source_title: Google sued over teen's access to Gemini on Chromebook
claims.supporting_quote: The lawsuit names Google CEO Sundar Pichai and cofounder Sergey Brin specifically, and accuses the company of "defective design, failure to warn, negligence, fraudulent concealment, and infliction of emotional distress."

claims.claim: Three U.S. House committees summoned Jensen Huang to a closed-door briefing later this month over ties to Alice Huang, reportedly identified as a Chinese spy.
claims.episode_span: Leaders of three U.S. House committees have summoned Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang to a closed-door briefing later this month.
claims.source_title: Jensen Huang Asked to Brief Congress Over Alleged Chinese Spy Plot
claims.supporting_quote: Leaders of three U.S. House committees have summoned Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to a closed-door briefing later this month over his ties to Alice Huang, a tech executive reportedly identified as a Chinese spy.

claims.claim: The new iPad mini starts at $699, is 5.4mm thin and 255 grams, uses an A20 Pro, and has an IP67 rating, with a 60Hz display.
claims.episode_span: The 8.5-inch iPad mini, 5.4mm and 255 grams, starts at $699 for 128GB Wi-Fi; it uses an A20 Pro and carries an IP67 rating, and early reviews have criticized the 60Hz display.
claims.source_title: OLED iPad Mini, M6 iMac, and New MacBook Pros Available From Today
claims.supporting_quote: At 5.4mm thin and 255 grams, it's the lightest iPad Apple has made. It's also the first iPad with an IP67 water and dust resistance rating

claims.claim: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash supports up to 15-second clips, costs $0.07 per second at 720p, and is 30 percent cheaper than Omni 1.1 Flash.
claims.episode_span: Google priced 720p output at $0.07 a second, 30 percent below Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash.
claims.source_title: Google Officially Announces Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash Video Generation AI
claims.supporting_quote: Furthermore, its price has been reduced by 30% compared to the previous-generation “Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash” , becoming available at $0.07 per second for 720p video.

claims.claim: Nvidia is stepping up monitoring of AI accelerators sold in Southeast Asia to curtail smuggling.
claims.episode_span: Nvidia is stepping up monitoring of AI accelerators sold in Southeast Asia.
claims.source_title: Nvidia Boosts Chip Tracking in Southeast Asia to Fight Smuggling
claims.supporting_quote: Nvidia Corp. is stepping up monitoring of AI accelerators sold in Southeast Asia, a strategic step to curtail semiconductor smuggling after criticism it hasn’t done enough to stop shipments from illegally reaching Chinese companies.

claims.claim: Google announced a $17 billion Wyoming data center with carbon capture.
claims.episode_span: Carbon Herald reports that Google announced a $17 billion data center in Wyoming paired with carbon capture.
claims.source_title: Google Announces $17B Wyoming Data Center With Carbon Capture
claims.supporting_quote: Google Announces $17B Wyoming Data Center With Carbon Capture

claims.claim: Counterpoint says iPhone ASP hit $1,031, up 19 percent year over year, and Apple shipments were nearly flat while Samsung led unit share 22 percent to 21 percent.
claims.episode_span: iPhone average selling price hit $1,031, up 19 percent year over year, while Apple shipments were nearly flat.
claims.source_title: Report: Apple captured half of global smartphone revenue in Q3
claims.supporting_quote: In another record, Counterpoint says Apple saw the iPhone average selling price (ASP) hit an all-time-high of $1,031, up 19% year-over-year.

claims.claim: Omdia says Apple shipped 11.5 million iPads in Q3 2026, down 27.5 percent, in a market that fell from 41.8 million to 32.2 million units.
claims.episode_span: Omdia, via 9to5Mac, says Apple shipped 11.5 million iPads in the third quarter, 36 percent of a market that fell from 41.8 million units to 32.2 million, a 27.5 percent drop for Apple
claims.source_title: Report: iPad shipments drop 27.5% as global tablet market plunges in Q3
claims.supporting_quote: According to a new report published by Omdia (via MacMagazine ), Apple shipped 11,5 million iPads during Q3 2026, accounting for 36% of all shipments.

claims.claim: Meta, Google, and TikTok are suing California's attorney general over a law that would restrict social media access for children under 16 if it takes effect next year.
claims.episode_span: Meta, Google, and TikTok are suing California's attorney general over a law that, if it takes effect next year, would restrict social media access for children under 16.
claims.source_title: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law
claims.supporting_quote: If it goes into effect next year, this California law would restrict social media access for children under 16.

claims.claim: José Castañeda said Google is reviewing the claims and takes them very seriously.
claims.episode_span: Google spokesperson José Castañeda said the company is reviewing the claims and takes them very seriously
claims.source_title: Google Sued Over Gemini Chat That Allegedly Coached Teen's Suicide Plan
claims.supporting_quote: "We are reviewing the claims in the lawsuit and we take this very seriously," Google spokesperson José Castañeda said.
